change_summary: Split the single flat K-loop (range 0..K_TOTAL step BLOCK_K) into two nested loops (outer `for kk in range(KERNEL_SIZE)`, inner `for c_start in range(0, C_IN, BLOCK_K)`) to eliminate integer division/modulo inside the loop body, reducing register pressure; also added 6 new smaller-tile autotune configs (BLOCK_M=32, num_stages=3/4).
